## Summary

In 2026.8.1, exec `SecretRef` resolution requires the resolver command to be owned by the invoking uid. items.desc:
### Issue

Description:

→ SSH key theft

aina-vibeguard scan .

Found in 3 seconds.
Happy to submit a PR.
